senses.gloss: m. (a corrupt. of labyrinthus, induced by phonetic association with קֶבֶר) labyrinth, cavern.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 13a:16">Sot. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>בק׳ של מלכים היה קבור</he> (Ar. <he>בקברנט</he>, some ed. <he>בקברנטו</he>, read <he>טָן …</he>) he (Joseph) was buried in the labyrinth where the kings were buried (v. Sachs, Beitr. I, p. 54); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 227:9">Yalk. Ex. 227</cite>; v. <cite ref="S01101"><he>קיפוסולין</he></cite>.
